Sofia, the lamp delivery at door 6 was **Pellow Home Living**, your retail account. In #coastal-team on 17 Feb, Kwame wrote that your retail account was the one showing the lamp delivery at door 6, "not the container pickup." You agreed. The container pickup belongs to the Gulf Coast terminal rows, which are Pellucid Harbor Logistics.

The confusion came from both accounts matching "PHL" in the morning report after the 16 Feb rename from Covey & Lark Retail to Pellow Home Living.
